#!/bin/sh
set -eu
CERT=/etc/nginx/tls/node1.crt
KEY=/etc/nginx/tls/node1.key
RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS=${RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS:-604800}
VALID_DAYS=${VALID_DAYS:-30}
if [ "${FORCE_RENEW:-0}" != "1" ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi
node_ip=$(ip -4 addr show scope global | awk '/inet / {sub("/.*", "", $2); print $2; exit}')
[ -n "$node_ip" ]
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /etc/nginx/tls/.renew.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days "$VALID_DAYS" \
    -subj '/CN=node1' -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$node_ip" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/node1.key" -out "$tmpdir/node1.crt" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 0600 "$tmpdir/node1.key"
chmod 0644 "$tmpdir/node1.crt"
mv -f "$tmpdir/node1.key" "$KEY"
mv -f "$tmpdir/node1.crt" "$CERT"
if rc-service nginx status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    nginx -t >/dev/null 2>&1
    rc-service nginx reload >/dev/null
fi
serial=$(openssl x509 -in "$CERT" -noout -serial | cut -d= -f2)
printf '%s renewed serial=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$serial" >> /var/log/tls-renew.log
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert
cat > /etc/nginx/http.d/default.conf <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
server {
    listen 8443 ssl;
    listen [::]:8443 ssl;
    server_name node1;

    ssl_certificate     /etc/nginx/tls/node1.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/tls/node1.key;
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

    location / {
        default_type text/plain;
        return 200 "node1 HTTPS service\n";
    }
}
ANTRIEB_EOF
